chapter.verse: Topa tungah lungdamna ko un, bang hang hiam cih leh amah hoih a, ama itna kip kho tawntung hi!
Tua mah bangin, nisuahna leh nitumna, leilu leh leitaw lam leitung pan-a ama kaihkhop, galte khutsung pan-a tatkhiat, Topa ’ tatkhiatsa mite in ci ta uh hen.
Pawlkhatte gamlakah gammang uh a, a teen’ nading uh khuapi tun’na lampi mu lo uh hi;
gilkial dangtakin amaute sibup uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in a lungkhamna uh-ah Topa ko uh a, amau cihmawhna panin amah in honkhia hi;
amau’ teen’ nading khuapi a tun’ matengun amah in lampi man-ah amaute paipih hi.
Ama itna kip leh mihing tate tungah a lamdang ama nasepnate hangin amaute in Topa ’ tungah lungdamna ko ta uh hen!
Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in a dangtakte phasak a, a gilkialte nahoih tawh vah sak hi.
Pawlkhatte, khuamial sung leh a ziing sungah tu uh a, sikkol kibulhin gimna thuakin thongkia uh hi,
bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in Pasian’ thute lehdo uh a, Sang Penpa’ thugente nial uh hi.
Nasep haksatna tawh amaute’ lungsim niamsak hi; amaute puk uh a, a huh ding kuamah om lo hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in a lungkhamna uh-ah Topa ko uh a, amau cihmawhna panin amah in honkhia hi;
amah in, khuamial sung leh a ziing sung panin amaute lakhia a, amau a kihennate botsatkhia hi.
Ama itna kip leh mihing tate tungah a lamdang ama nasepnate hangin amaute in Topa ’ tungah lungdamna ko ta uh hen!
Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in sumngo kongkhakte sukhamin, sikzawlte tum nih suah hi.
Pawlkhatte, amaute’ khialhna hangin, gimna thuak uh a, amau lehdona hangin hailawh uh hi.
amaute in an peuhmah kih uh hi, amaute, sihna kongpi nai ta uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in a lungkhamna uh-ah Topa ko uh a, amau cihmawhna panin amah in honkhia hi;
amah in ama’ thu vaikhakin, amaute dam sak a, siat nading panin amaute honkhia hi.
Ama itna kip leh mihing tate tungah a lamdang ama nasepnate hangin amaute in Topa ’ tungah lungdamna ko ta uh hen!
Lungdamkoh piaknate pia-in, ama nasepnate lungdam late tawh amaute gen sak un!
Pawlkhatte, teembaw tawh tuipi-ah pai uh a, tuiliante tungah sumbawl na sem uh hi;
amaute in, tuithuk tungah Topa ’ gamtatna, a lamdang ama septe mu uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in thupia a, tuipi hualte piangsaka, huihpi nungsak hi.
Amaute, van-ah kilawnto-in, a thukna-ah kiasuk uh hi; a lauhuai siatna sungah amau lungsim han’na bei hi;
amaute zukham bangin hoisuk hoito uh a, a cih nading mel uh thei nawn lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in a lungkhamna uh-ah Topa ko uh a, amau cihmawhna panin amah in honkhia hi.
Amah in huihpi dai sak a tuipi hualte a bei hi.
Tua ciangin, tua tuihualte a khawl manin amaute lungdam uh hi, amah in amaute’ utna khua-ah paipih hi.
Ama itna kip leh mihing tate tungah a lamdang ama nasepnate hangin amaute in Topa ’ tungah lungdamna ko ta uh hen!
Amaute in mihonte kikhopna sungah amah pahtawi-in, upate kikhopna sungah amah phat ta uh hen.
Amah in, a tung a teeng mihingte’ gitlohna hangin, gunte sehnel gam suak sakin, ciktuite leikeu suak sak a, an tampi a pian’na leitang pen ci lei suak sak hi.
Amah in sehnel gam pen bualtuite suaksak a, leitang keu pen ciktui suak sak hi.
Amah in, tua munah gilkialte teeng sak a, amaute in a teen’ nading uh khuapi khat sat uh hi;
amaute in lo-ah an tuhin, leenggui suan uh a, a gah tampi tak ngah uh hi.
Ama thupha tawh ante nakpi takin pung hi; amah in, amau bawngte zong kiam sak lo hi.
Amaute pen, nen’niamna, haksatna leh dahna tawh kikhiamin a kiniamkoih ciangin,
amah in, uliante tungah simmawhna buaksukin, lampi om lohna gam sungah vakvai sak hi;
ahih hangin amah in thuakna sung panin a cimawhte laamto a, tuu honpite bangin amau innkuante pung sak hi.
Lungsim thutangte in hih thu mu in kipak uh hi; a gilo khempeuhte in ahih leh amau kam a cih ciat uh hi.
A pil peuhmah in hih thute don hen la; Topa ’ itna kip lungngaingai ta hen.
